question: Which months between 2002 and June 2026 did Luxembourg import more goods from China than it exported to France?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
One month (Nov 2002, import) is far above the usual level; spikes like this often come from a few large shipments. It is flagged, not removed.

sql:
SELECT
  period AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2002-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND partner IN ('CN', 'FR')
GROUP BY
  period,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: exports: +41.5 % (Jan 2002–Jun 2026)
insight: Luxembourg did not import more goods from China than it exported to France in any month between 2002 and June 2026 based on the available data.
Exports started at 176.9 million euros in January 2002 and increased by 41.5% to 250.3 million euros by June 2026.
Imports began at 140.5 million euros in January 2002 and rose by 94.6% to 273.6 million euros by June 2026, with a peak of 734.7 million euros in November 2008.
The highest export value was 536.5 million euros in November 2025, which is well above the import peak, indicating exports to France remained higher than imports from China.
The data are in current euros and not adjusted for price changes, and one import value in November 2002 is unusually high due to a few large shipments.
